ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA Open-ended Question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: The factors affecting the relocation of enterprises or enterprise departments are each different. The figure below schematically shows a comparison of the enterprise relocation motivations of different relocation subjects. <image1> According to the figure, among the following factors affecting enterprise relocation, which belong to policy factors? Please write the numbers: 1 old city renovation 2 scale expansion 3 location preference 4 environmental management.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a comparison of enterprise relocation motivations of different relocation subjects such as the enterprise as a whole, enterprise headquarters, production departments, and R&D departments, in the form of multiple pie charts; the legend divides relocation motivations into types such as “policy factors, strategic factors, economic factors, emotional factors.” Reasoning: The question requires judging, among 1 old city renovation, 2 scale expansion, 3 location preference, and 4 environmental management, which belong to policy factors. Policy factors usually refer to relocation caused by external institutional forces such as government planning, regulations, and management requirements. Old city renovation belongs to being promoted by urban planning and renewal policies, and environmental management belongs to constraints from environmental protection regulation and management policies; scale expansion is an enterprise’s own development strategy, and location preference is more inclined toward site selection or economic location factors. Therefore, those belonging to policy factors are 1 and 4.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中是不同迁移主体的企业迁移动因比较，图例把动因分为“政策因素、战略因素、经济因素、情感因素”。再读题干给出的四个候选项：1旧城改造、2规模扩张、3区位偏好、4环境管理。根据“政策因素”通常指由政府规划、法规、管理要求等外部制度力量引起的迁移，判断旧城改造属于城市规划政策推动，环境管理属于环保监管政策约束；规模扩张是企业自身发展战略，区位偏好是企业选址偏好或经济区位考虑。因此写序号1、4。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中展示了企业整体、企业总部、生产部门、研发部门等不同迁移主体的企业迁移动因比较，形式为多个饼图；图例把迁移动因分为“政策因素、战略因素、经济因素、情感因素”等类型。推理：题目要求在1旧城改造、2规模扩张、3区位偏好、4环境管理中判断哪些属于政策因素。政策因素通常指由政府规划、法规和管理要求等外部制度力量引起的迁移。旧城改造属于城市规划和更新政策推动，环境管理属于环保监管和管理政策约束；规模扩张是企业自身发展战略，区位偏好更偏向选址或经济区位因素。因此属于政策因素的是1和4。
